crossRefs.note: All my bones shall say, “Yahweh, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the…
They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.
My God has sent his angel, and has shut the lions’ mouths, and they have not hurt me; because as before him innocence…
For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”

translations.web: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.
